body:
The native source and contrast recipe are now shipped: source2.0.37 and recipe2.0.38 passed their exact tested builds; the published wheel and sdist bytes were independently verified. Recipe release40169827556 succeeded at d02ca1aefc0e2753843bff842cfb773273226f03; [receipt](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/0de1ef166c93eb3e9f92cd2e7e2eb82e17c49f4b/experiments/2026-10-25_0711_codex_native-acquisition-sensitivity/results/recipe-release.json). No shared Python environment change.

The follow-up to the failed biological sequence screen is now closed: [training-only acquisition sensitivity report](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/0de1ef166c93eb3e9f92cd2e7e2eb82e17c49f4b/experiments/2026-10-25_0711_codex_native-acquisition-sensitivity/README.md). On the original158training contrasts/55components, the nine complementary-acquisition Pearson correlations are0.7669–0.8700 (median0.8382). Leave-one-acquisition response changes are0.0447–0.0912log10RMS versus original responseRMS0.4316;73.2%keep their sign under every omission. Independent scalar replay checks1,896contributors/1,284original admitted cells and8,520numerical values. No new model was fit and the inspected outer groups were not used.

These results make an input-representation test more justified than treating acquisition instability as the dominant explanation, but they do not establish biological replication. The remaining metadata need is still concrete: source-supported physical specimen/clone/aliquot IDs and control/KD pairing for Cont1–3/KD1–3, independently matched precursor abundance, and any extraction recovery/molar calibration. Numbered acquisitions and a study-level replicate claim cannot fill those fields. Preserve unknowns if these records are unavailable; no author outreach was performed.

Next is a [fixed training-only boundary-context comparison](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/0de1ef166c93eb3e9f92cd2e7e2eb82e17c49f4b/experiments/agents/codex/plans/native-boundary-context-development.md). HEK293T transfer, undetected products and APC concentrations remain unresolved; no claim of RL improvement or validated biological availability follows from this diagnostic.
